evals.prompt: 我有一份约 1.2 万字的产品经理培训材料，目标读者是刚转岗的新人。先帮我判断适合拆成多少章、多少节，并解释依据；这一步不要查询任何线上课程数据。
evals.expected_output: Treats lesson-count estimation as authoring, completes the authoring prerequisites, and does not route to analytics.
expectations: The response treats the requested chapter and lesson count as a course-design question, not as live-course analytics.
The workflow follows authentication and course-target resolution before proposing an outline.
No analytics DSL query or credit-detail command is attempted.
Because this request only plans structure and does not create or modify course content, it does not deploy or publish a course.

evals.prompt: 帮我看一下已经发布的《销售新人训练营》最近 30 天有多少学习者、完成率是多少，以及最容易卡住的是哪一节。
evals.expected_output: Routes to live-course analytics, resolves credentials and current course identity, and translates results before presentation.
expectations: The workflow uses authentication.md and the analytics workflow.
The current course title and shifu_bid are resolved before metric queries.
Lesson-level results resolve outline IDs and do not expose raw IDs or codes.

evals.prompt: 课程内容不用改。请把我现有的 AI 师傅课程发布出去，并给我预览和正式访问地址。
evals.expected_output: Routes only to authentication and deployment/publishing instructions without loading authoring phases.
expectations: The workflow verifies authentication before publish operations.
It does not run Course Design Intake, Segmentation, Generation, or Optimization.
Verification URLs are copied from CLI output and formatted with the deployment report rules.

evals.prompt: 只审查我贴出来的这节 MarkdownFlow，不重做课程结构。重点检查互动语法、变量是否滥用，以及开头有没有重复课节标题。
evals.expected_output: Routes to the focused optimization path with prompt contracts, without loading unrelated generation or segmentation workflows.
expectations: The workflow loads prompt-contracts.md and optimization-workflow.md.
The workflow does not authenticate or resolve a platform course for this pasted-snippet-only audit.
It does not run Segmentation or the Course Design Intake.
The audit covers interaction syntax, variable scope, and structural metadata.

evals.prompt: 把线上课程第 4 节的授课提示词更新成我提供的新版本，其他课节、价格、权限和 TTS 设置都不要动。
evals.expected_output: Treats this as an existing-course content update, automatically writes and publishes it through the non-destructive sync workflow, and preserves unrelated attributes.
expectations: The workflow loads authentication, course-target, prompt-contracts, and deployment instructions.
It pulls the existing course and uses a granular content update rather than import --new.
It preserves unrelated course attributes and handles revision conflicts with the convergence loop.
After the granular content write succeeds, it publishes and verifies the course without asking for a separate deployment instruction.

evals.prompt: 把这份内部培训文档做成一门新的 AI 师傅互动课；课程完成后再告诉我学习人数。
evals.expected_output: Automatically combines the full authoring, deployment, publication, and analytics routes in dependency order even though deployment was not requested separately.
expectations: The workflow resolves authentication and the course target before authoring.
It runs intake, authoring phases, prompt validation, and safe new-course deployment in order.
Analytics runs only after the live course target exists.

evals.prompt: 材料只有两课时：第一课“识别风险信号”，第二课“选择处置动作”。Course Design Intake 已完成，我只选择在课程开头收集 learner_context。这里只做不落平台的设计概要，请给出两课时的 Teaching Prompt 规划，标明各课的教学循环和交互安排；不要因此给每节课都加互动，也不要增加课前思考或课末自检。
evals.expected_output: Applies the single enabled purpose only at its canonical placement without expanding interaction coverage.
expectations: The interaction policy is enabled with exactly learner_context selected; pre_content_thinking and lesson_end_self_check remain unselected.
Learner context is collected at an early course or module point without making every lesson interactive.
Lessons without the selected-purpose placement use a worked application or consolidation in the lesson loop instead of an added interaction.
The response contains exactly two lesson outlines and explicitly identifies the teaching loop and interaction arrangement for each lesson.
The artifact-only design route does not authenticate, deploy, or publish.

evals.prompt: 这是不落平台的规则工件演示。Course Design Intake 已明确选择 disabled。原课节先问“当前风险更可能来自哪里？”，再用 ?[%{{risk_source}} 人员 | 流程 | 工具] 收集答案并按答案分支。请直接输出改写后的 Teaching Prompt、used_variables 和 global_variable_table：把该选择题改成一个完整的 worked application，不能询问学员答案，也不能保留回答变量或按回答分支。
evals.expected_output: Converts disabled interaction slots into model-led worked application while removing all answer-dependent behavior.
expectations: The disabled policy is applied with no learner-answer variables: used_variables and global_variable_table are both empty.
The result contains no ?[] interaction, learner-answer request, learner-answer variable, or answer-dependent branch.
The former interaction becomes a worked application, model-led example, or consolidation that preserves the teaching function.
The explicitly artifact-only demonstration does not access or modify a platform course.

evals.prompt: 设计两节课：第一节先让学员选 A 或 B，并立刻给出对应解释，这个答案后面不再使用；另问一个学习目标，第二节和 Course Prompt 都要用到，而且 Course Prompt 可能在目标采集前先运行。请展示两种交互写法、global_variable_table，以及目标尚未填写时的处理。
evals.expected_output: Separates lesson-local answers from cross-lesson state and preserves the UNKNOWN substitution fallback.
expectations: The lesson-local A/B interaction uses no-variable ?[...] syntax and creates no global_variable_table entry.
The learning goal uses one named variable whose global_variable_table entry is collected_in L01, has cross_lesson scope, and lists the later lesson and course_prompt in used_in.
Any pre-collection reference binds the substituted value and branches on the literal UNKNOWN fallback rather than testing variable availability or readiness.

evals.prompt: 同一份材料的核心概念是“风险 = 概率 × 影响”，并需要一张二维矩阵概念图；我还提供了一张“团队在白板前标注高风险事项”的图片及这句图片说明。这里只比较方案，不创建或修改平台课程。请给出标准 AI 授课与纯课堂幻灯片两种结构方案，并说明已提供图片的理解、上传和嵌入计划（无需真实上传）。两种方案都不能内嵌 SVG、HTML、Mermaid、PlantUML 或 Graphviz 源码。
evals.expected_output: Applies the standard and slide-only visual contracts separately while keeping raw graphics code out of both prompts.
expectations: The standard non-slide-only Teaching Prompt pairs the core visual with a complete textual explanation and handles the provided image through the existing understand-upload-embed workflow.

The pure classroom-slide result uses delivery_mode pure_slides with listen_mode_enabled false and is concise and projection-ready for a human instructor without AI narration or a required full explanatory paragraph.

Neither result embeds raw SVG, HTML, Mermaid, PlantUML, or Graphviz source; without a real upload, the provided-image plan uses upload-image, valid deterministic MarkdownFlow image syntax, and only the real returned platform URL rather than an invented illustrative URL.
Because the prompt requests mutually exclusive design options rather than a platform mutation, neither option is deployed.

evals.prompt: 只审查这节课并给修改建议：我同时贴了课程材料和现有 Teaching Prompt。不要扩展成整门课，也不要生成 Course Prompt。
evals.expected_output: Keeps a focused Optimization audit scoped to the supplied lesson and does not synthesize a course_prompt.
expectations: The response returns the focused audit artifacts for the supplied lesson.
It does not generate or return a new course_prompt merely because course_material is present.
It does not expand the request into full-course authoring.
The pasted-content audit does not authenticate, resolve a course target, deploy, or publish.

evals.prompt: 这是不创建或修改平台课程的规范工件演示。继续兼容这份旧请求：chapter_hint.target_lessons=2，chapter_hint.granularity=short，course_profile.lesson_count_target=2，generation_constraints.lesson_granularity=short，generation_constraints.persona=严谨教练，teaching_constraints.max_interactions=3。请生成单课结果，并把归一化结果和冲突报告一起给我。
evals.expected_output: Normalizes legacy aliases once into authoring_constraints and keeps the canonical array-shaped Generation output.
expectations: Equivalent legacy aliases normalize once to lesson_count_target and authoring_constraints fields before phase execution.
Canonical fields would win over conflicting aliases, and ignored conflicts are recorded in the phase report rather than silently discarded.
Even for one lesson, Generation returns lesson_teaching_prompts as an array and no legacy wrapper keys remain in the handoff.
The explicitly artifact-only compatibility demonstration does not deploy or publish.

evals.prompt: 只部署我现有的课程目录，不改课程内容和 TTS。里面有一张本地图片、一张外链图片和一张已经是 AI 师傅平台资源的图片。
evals.expected_output: Preserves standalone deployment settings and routes only unresolved image resources through the shared image workflow.
expectations: The deploy-only route does not ask for a delivery mode and does not modify TTS.
Local and external images are understood, uploaded, embedded with returned platform URLs, and validated through image-assets.md.
The already-valid platform resource is left unchanged, and no URL is invented.

evals.prompt: 这门线上课看起来全是课堂投屏页，但我现在明确要求开启 Listen Mode；内容和其他属性都不要动。
evals.expected_output: Treats explicit standalone Listen Mode management as a platform operation and enables it despite slide-like content.
expectations: The workflow authenticates and enters Listen Mode management without running authoring intake or inferring a delivery mode.
It may provide a non-blocking warning about slide-like content but does not refuse the explicit enable request.
Only the requested TTS setting is changed; lesson content and unrelated attributes remain untouched.

evals.prompt: 登录时接口返回 smsSendTooFrequent。我已经收到刚才那条验证码 123456，请继续；如果这次没收到，就不要自动再发。
evals.expected_output: Uses the outstanding SMS code after a rate-limit response and never retries merely because delivery is delayed.
expectations: The supplied code is submitted against the existing login attempt without requesting another SMS code.
If no code arrives, the current login attempt ends with advice to retry later instead of automatically resending.
The separate one-time final resend remains limited to the third consecutive wrong-code path.

evals.prompt: 查课程最近 30 天的下单人数、成功下单人数、付费人数、订单数、退款人数，并给完整状态漏斗。
evals.expected_output: Uses distinct backend status and aggregation contracts for each order metric.
expectations: Placed-order users count distinct user_bid for statuses 501, 502, and 504; successful-order users count distinct user_bid at status 502.
Paid users require status 502 and paid_price greater than zero; order count counts status-502 rows; refund users count status-503 users.
The full funnel groups all statuses without applying a status filter.

evals.prompt: 查标题包含‘销售训练营’的课程过去一年改过哪些历史标题，再按旧标题查学习数据。
evals.expected_output: Uses find-title only for current titles and clearly refuses unsupported historical-title matching.
expectations: Title keyword resolution uses find-title rather than published or draft analytics recipes.
Published and draft recipes are used only after an exact shifu_bid is known.
The response states that historical-title lookup is not currently supported and does not fabricate a historical match or dangling query.

evals.prompt: 逐条列出最近的学员追问并标出是谁问的；不要显示内部 ID。然后再给一个按课节聚合的追问数量。
evals.expected_output: Uses the unique safe identity lookup for row-level follow-ups and skips identity lookup for the aggregate.
expectations: Row-level follow-ups resolve known user_bid values in a restricted batch lookup and display Learner A with safe nickname and masked identity.
Raw user_bid values, fuzzy nickname search, user enumeration, and unmasked identities are never shown.
The lesson-level aggregate does not query identities; an explicit anonymity request would replace labels with ordinals only.
